pages.text: Kasuku Equity Fund factsheet, issued by Mto Asset Managers (SYN). Kasuku Equity Fund is a equity fund and its objective is to grow capital by investing mainly in listed companies. The management fee of Kasuku Equity Fund is 2.1 percent per annum. The minimum initial investment in Kasuku Equity Fund is SYN Sh 500, and the minimum top-up is SYN Sh 500. Over the 12 months to 2026-09-30 Kasuku Equity Fund delivered an effective annual return of 17.3 percent.

Withdrawals from Kasuku Equity Fund are paid within 3 business days. The main holdings of Kasuku Equity Fund are retail shares (50 percent), telecom shares (35 percent) and bank shares (30 percent). Bara Custodial (SYN) acts as trustee of Kasuku Equity Fund and holds its assets separately from the manager. Kasuku Equity Fund was launched in 2015 and is licensed by the SYN Capital Markets Authority. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results and the value of units can fall.
